purpose: Prevent research convenience from creating an unintended commercial licensing dependency while preserving evidence-informed model development.

examples: FSFFL/Sleeper league transactions and roster states that the project is entitled to use
internally generated simulations and model diagnostics

OPEN_OR_COMMERCIALLY_PERMITTED.requirement: License, terms, public-domain status, or other permission must support the intended commercial use.

COMMERCIAL_LICENSED.requirement: License scope must cover the actual production/commercial use.

forbidden_use: materially determining a commercial production coefficient
embedding restricted raw tables in production artifacts

production_parameter_requirements: record whether the production value materially depends on external source data
retain a commercially safe fallback or independently reproducible basis where feasible
do not label a parameter commercially ready if a material source dependency is rights-unclear or research-only

preferred_calibration_sources: open or commercially-permitted historical factual data
research_only_external_sources: may be consulted to challenge assumptions or prior bounds
must not become the material numerical basis of a commercial production parameter unless rights are cleared

review_status.current_external_sources: SOURCE-BY-SOURCE RIGHTS REVIEW REQUIRED BEFORE COMMERCIAL LAUNCH
review_status.note: This policy does not make a legal determination about any named provider. It creates the governance mechanism needed to track and resolve those determinations.
